name: popsicle
headline: Instagram Bot - Automate Engagement
short_description: Instagram bot automates user engagement by following accounts, liking posts, and leaving comments. Marketing teams use it to increase brand visibility and audience interaction. It connects to Instagram and integrates with marketing automation workflows.
author: somiibo

sections.overview:
Instagram Bot is free automation software that helps grow Instagram accounts organically by automatically following users and liking and commenting on posts. The tool targets users based on your criteria, and those engaged users are more likely to become organic followers. It works by running on your computer (Windows, macOS, or Linux) and managing interactions at scale without manual effort. Social media managers and marketing teams use it to increase brand visibility and audience interaction without hiring additional staff. The bot handles repetitive engagement tasks, freeing up time for content strategy and community management.
Growing Instagram followers organically for personal brands or small businesses
Increasing engagement on posts in competitive niches
Automating community outreach to target audiences
Building follower bases for new Instagram accounts
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/somiibo/instagram-bot`
sections.usage:
```
Use the Instagram bot to automate engagement for [BRAND_NAME] by: 1) Following 50-100 new accounts per day that match [TARGET_AUDIENCE_CRITERIA], 2) Liking the 10 most recent posts from each followed account, and 3) Leaving a personalized comment like '[COMMENT_TEMPLATE]' on 5 of those posts. Run this sequence daily between [TIME_RANGE].
```
Copy

```
Engagement Report for Brand: EcoThread Collective

=== Followed Accounts (Day 1) ===
- Followed 72 accounts matching criteria (sustainable fashion, eco-conscious consumers, ages 18-35). Target: 50-100/day.
- Top followed accounts: @GreenThreadCo (12K followers), @SustainableStitch (8.5K), @EcoChicDaily (6.2K).

=== Likes Executed ===
- Liked 10 recent posts from each followed account (720 total likes).
- Highest engagement posts: @GreenThreadCo's post on biodegradable packaging (1.2K likes, 45 comments) and @SustainableStitch's video on ethical sourcing (890 likes, 32 comments).

=== Comments Executed ===
- Left personalized comments on 5 posts using template: 'Love your commitment to sustainability! 🌿 Have you checked out our new [PRODUCT_NAME] collection? It’s made with [MATERIAL] and [BENEFIT]. #EcoThread #SustainableFashion'
- Comments posted on: @GreenThreadCo (post about recycled fabrics), @EcoChicDaily (post on zero-waste tips), @SustainableStitch (video on slow fashion), @EcoFashionista (post on thrifting), @GreenLifeBlog (post on ethical brands).

=== Engagement Results ===
- Total new followers gained: 47 (organic growth from followed accounts).
- Profile visits: +18% (from 2,145 to 2,530).
- Comments on own posts: +22% (from 15 to 18).
- Top comment engagement: @GreenThreadCo’s post received 12 replies to our comment within 2 hours.

=== Recommendations ===
- Adjust comment template to include a question (e.g., 'What’s your favorite sustainable brand?') to boost replies.
- Focus on accounts with higher engagement rates (500+ likes per post) for future follows.
- Schedule this sequence for 8-10 AM daily to align with peak Instagram activity for the target audience.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
